newsitem.title: USA: Bus crashes in Calif. after driver has heart attack.
newsitem.headline: Bus crashes in Calif. after driver has heart attack.

text.p: A commuter bus lost control and veered off the road in Campbell, California, Thursday after its driver suffered a fatal heart attack, emergency officials said. Several passengers were injured.
Paramedics found the 57-year-old driver slumped over the steering wheel. "He was in full arrest. No pulse. No breathing," said Rick Reed, director of the local office of emergency services.
Hospital officials said later they were unable to revive the driver.

The Valley Transportation Authority bus, carrying 25 passengers, veered from the road and came to a stop after crashing into trees and a fence outside an office park about 45 miles south of San Francisco.
Paramedics said at least 10 passengers suffered injuries in the accident, which occurred at about 7:30 a.m. local time, and were taken to hospitals. Most of the injuries were minor.
No one on the street or in the office park was hurt.
